name: ns_axi_dirichlet
description: axisymmetric NS MMS with swirl on (r, z) in [0,1]^2: Dirichlet on r = 1, z = 0, z = 1; axis r = 0 (u_r = u_t = 0 strongly; u_z, p natural); variable mu (even in r), rho = 5/4; parity-respecting

conventions.planar: u = (u_x, u_y); grad_u[i][j] = d u_i / d x_j; sigma_sym = 2 mu eps - p I, sigma_lap = mu G - p I; f = rho (u.grad)u - div sigma_form; traction g = sigma_form n (outward n)
conventions.axisymmetric: coords (r, z); u = (u_r, u_theta, u_z); grad_u[i][j] = d u_i / d (r, z)_j (component derivatives, NOT the cylindrical gradient tensor); f in the (e_r, e_theta, e_z) frame, f = rho G u - div sigma_form with G and div as in tools/fluids_mms/f2a_fields.py
